title: Glamping scene and topic analysis workflow

runtime_environment.runtime_note: Runtime depends on hardware and installed dependencies.

pipeline_steps.purpose: Select If pic=Y from 3,176 source reviews and require exact ID agreement with the 3,068 supplied manual-coding records.
Filter image tags, cluster WMD profiles, fit rotated factors, and derive scene memberships from fitted argmax factor assignments.
Build scene frequencies, topic keywords, co-occurrence tables, and normalized scene-topic contributions.
Plot nine-topic coordinates from the retained LDA visualization.
Plot the newly fitted 50 by 16 factor loading matrix.
Summarize campsite distribution and operational name groups.
Score all 431 validation images with the retained ResNet18 checkpoint.
Calculate fixed-split validation metrics and plot the confusion matrix; read historical fold accuracies separately.
Generate Grad-CAM examples from the retained checkpoint and validation images.
Generate a representative validation prediction image grid.

Build group-ID lookup tables linking keywords, word clusters (group0..group49), assigned PCA factors and names, ritual scenes, and taxonomy subclasses via the human-reviewed group-to-subclass codebook.
Compute the parallel-analysis benchmark for the fitted eigenvalues and plot the scree plot and cumulative variance used to document the 16-factor decision.

artifact_notes.historical_procedures: Selected WMD and LDA traces are in code_original/ and excluded from main.py; exact early upstream resources and environment are not supplied.

image_records.duplicate_image_policy: Retain all source rows; no image-content deduplication.
image_records.fit_order: Fit PCA on candidate images before manual eligibility filtering.
image_records.factor_naming: Original factor names; scene membership is derived solely from fitted argmax assignments via the factor table.
